props.name: 挂钟
props.shell: 钟壳、表盘、刻度和红色轴帽
props.review: 表壳正面保留十二刻度，背面不应有盘面；不要画指针。长短针分别回装，以同一轴心独立转动。

props.name: 霓虹标语
props.review: 程序霓虹管组成 BUILD；固定件、支架和回线沿用办公室程序网格。

props.name: 冲浪板
props.review: 整件静态；长板是带弧度的实体而非矩形板。正面青色条与橙色斜纹、背面板鳍不要对调。

props.lodReason: 先收敛网柱倒角细分，保持球网包围盒，防止远级整体缩放把细网线移出原位。
props.name: 乒乓球台
props.review: 大桌面与桌架沿用原件；若仅拆桌面和网，会把散腿与悬空球拍交给 AI。故只上传红拍，完整回装球网（含柱、带、网线）、台面白线、桌腿斜撑、另一把黑拍和球。验红拍落座、柄朝前。

props.lodReason: 32 株花的细茎、叶和花头在 840 面塌成尖片；1600 面四向最低 IoU 仍为 0.884，单独给远级 1800 面，近中级和完整性门槛沿用原值。
props.name: 花坛
props.review: 整件静态，三色花丛、土层和石边一体；按四行八株的疏密看，侧面仍可分辨花头与细茎，不能糊成色板。

props.name: 小盆栽
props.review: 整件保留叶簇和盆口；验叶间负形、露土和盆底着地，不要把枝叶连成实心球。

props.name: 中庭树
props.review: 树与环座同为静态陈设；核对树冠分层、分枝净空和一圈座板，不得吞掉树池。

props.lodReason: 减少计分珠和横杆附件的细分，让远级箱体及桌腿保有独立面数。
props.name: 桌上足球
props.shell: 桌腿及木箱体（含内场、围边）
props.review: 留空内场，不要补杆；四组横杆各带两名球员和手柄，分别绕本杆轴转动。球、计分珠和场线回装，不应贴死在箱体上。

props.name: 落地灯
props.review: 罩和底座之间刻意留空；细长灯杆、罩面细筋、电源线回装。保留金色顶饰，不要另生一根杆。

props.name: 篮球架
props.review: 只做配重箱，不补画球架；透明篮板、边框及标线、主杆与斜撑、篮圈与网都回装。验篮网中空、篮圈朝前。

props.name: 消防逃生梯
props.review: 双向开孔格栅、斜梁、折边踏步和扶手均随办公室程序网格导出。

props.name: 滑板
props.shell: 原第 8 批滑板的贴图板面
props.review: 仅复用归档模型的板面。两座轮桥与四个轮子从游戏原模回装，逐级核对独立网格。

props.lodReason: 直接塌边会压扁半开的盒盖；远级先按成品约 4 毫米体素重建，再减面并从原盒烘底色，保留层缝。
props.name: 叠放的披萨盒
props.review: 静态纸盒与披萨同做。四层盒缝、半开顶盖、半圆饼与红色配料要分得开，封签朝前；不加品牌字样。

props.name: 垃圾桶
props.review: 整件静态；保住深色桶盖和正面脚踏，脚踏不要并入桶身，标签不写字。

props.name: 挂轴
props.review: 旧纹理卷杆、程序红裱和 2K 题字纸面；正面读字，背面素净。

replacement.name: ink-paper
replacement.method: 复用归档卷杆；程序纸面与 2K 书法贴图，本地追加 0 积分

props.name: 吊灯
props.shell: 金属灯罩、发光盘及灯泡
props.review: 细吊线及吸顶帽回装，避免细线断裂。灯罩开口向下，保留暖白灯芯和顶端接线位置。

props.name: 致敬版陶瓷兔
props.prompt: Design one original ceramic rabbit for a playful miniature office toy shelf. Show the whole figure in a front three-quarter view, isolated on pure white. A compact crouch, tucked paws, one gently folded ear, warm clay showing through ivory glaze, a tiny irregular scan-like recess at the underside lip. Sculpt from scratch as an original homage; never use, trace, reconstruct or derive from the original Stanford Bunny scan, dataset or mesh. No text, logos or real trademarks.
props.review: 蹲姿、陶土露胎与白釉清楚，底缘有扫描缺口感但不掏穿主体；不用斯坦福兔原始数据。

props.name: 鲸鱼娘手办
props.prompt: A single original blue-and-white whale-themed girl vinyl figurine for a miniature office desk. Front three-quarter product view on a pure white background, entire figure visible. Shape the coat hem like a fluke, round the hood like a whale's head and use small fin-shaped sleeves. Simple painted eyes, cobalt and porcelain white, sturdy feet. Invent the character from scratch; no company names, lettering, corporate logos, real trademarks or existing mascots.
props.review: 蓝白少女轮廓明确，鳍袖与鲸尾造型可辨且能稳立；没有任何公司名、文字或标志。

props.name: 随机鹦鹉
props.prompt: One original colorful parrot desk toy perched on its own sturdy T-shaped stand. Front three-quarter view, pure white background, include the feet, tail and entire base. Chunky turquoise wings, coral cheek, golden breast and a curved beak; broad painted feather shapes rather than loose feathers. Match a playful miniature office collectible. Original design only, no text, logos or real trademarks.
props.review: 鹦鹉连站架全身入镜，双爪抓住横木，尾羽不与底座粘连，远看仍能分清喙和翅色。

props.name: 笑脸面具修格斯毛绒
props.prompt: Design one original squat cluster of soft plush tentacles with a separate yellow smile mask hanging on its front. Full front three-quarter product view against pure white. Use deep petrol felt, broad rounded tentacles, visible stitched seams and an asymmetric hand-embroidered smile of your own design. Charming rather than frightening, like a miniature office collectible. No borrowed characters, logos, text or real trademarks.
props.review: 前挂黄面具而非在本体印脸；触手团、绒布缝线和面具边缘能读出，整体可坐稳。

props.name: 羊驼毛绒
props.prompt: One original alpaca plush for a miniature office lounge. Show the entire toy from a front three-quarter angle on pure white. Give it a long upright neck, two short pointed ears, four stubby feet and cream fleece with a muted apricot muzzle. Use a few rounded wool tufts and embroidered eyes, not individual hairs. Create a new collectible silhouette; no company names, logos, lettering, existing mascots or real trademarks.
props.review: 长颈、双耳和四只短脚可读，绒面与口鼻区分明，沙发尺度合适；无任何公司名或标志。
